reply: Routed 13:20 CST Nov 9. It was filed earlier, but no reply was written here: the Home hand-off became four steps, each with its own lane. sim-tool-lease-check and lane-sim-hold-path are ready. sim-boot-screen-check and artifact-guard-matcher-names are in progress. Triage.
text:
feedback from home repo: Hand-off from the Home coordinator (shivinate7/home), 2026-11-08. Three gaps in claude-settings tools, found by Home's notes and debts sweep. Each is filed as a note in Home's docs/debts/notes.md (PR 581). Take each as a lane or a debt here, per your own rules.

1. no-sim-boot-path: a lane has no route that keeps an iPhone simulator booted for taps and screenshots.
   - `xcrun simctl boot` is refused by a guard.
   - `sim-test --hold` works only in the foreground. The worktree guard refuses it as a background run, so a lane cannot hold the sim and tap at the same time.
   - xcodebuild and the iOS Simulator MCP launch do not boot a device that is shut down.
   - Lanes also cannot wait on the gatekeeper's grants file (/Users/shivinate/Developer/sim-gate/grants). Hooks refuse a sleep loop, a polling Monitor and a stream follower, so the gatekeeper has to message each GO by hand, and its messages pause after 10 sends.
   - Harm: Home PR 576 (Duo idle Play page) merged with its Offline and held-tall screens unchecked on a device (2026-11-08). Duo 1 sat idle overnight on 2026-11-07.
   - Done when: a lane can boot or hold one simulator under a gatekeeper grant, run taps and screenshots against it, and wait for its GO line, all with no guard refusal.

2. boot-hook-screenshot-check: left over from Home waiting-page item 86 (duo-sim-fix). A boot hook should take a one-screen screenshot check after a sim boots, to prove the screen is live before a lane relies on it. The old Home triage-4 handoff marked it "the coordinator's to hand off"; it was never sent until now.
   - Done when: the hook exists with a test that goes red on a blank or black first frame, or a ruling drops it.

3. artifact-hook-matcher-names: unverified. Guard hook matchers in claude-settings may name the tools `Artifact` / `ArtifactData`, while sessions now call `mcp__claude-artifacts__*` (for example `mcp__claude-artifacts__db_write`, `db_get`, `publish_version`). If so, those guards never fire on the real tool calls. Source: Home triage-5 handoff, premise P5 ("advisor, unverified, checked never").
   - Done when: each guard that means to cover artifact tools matches the mcp__claude-artifacts__* names, proved by a test that goes red on the old matcher.

4. sim-tool-lease-check: the iOS Simulator tool drives a device with no check that the caller holds that device's sim-test lease. On 2026-11-08 between 10:43 and 10:50 CST, Home lane duo-rooms kept tapping the 18 Pro and switching it between light and dark after its 120 s hold ended, during another lane's turn. Done when: the tool refuses tap, screenshot and appearance actions on a device whose lease the caller does not hold, proved by a test that goes red without the check.

unsure if all still valid
